root_cause.summary: The deeper issue was an incomplete mental model of SciPy's matrix square root implementation. The agent first optimized around an eigendecomposition prototype, then discovered from SciPy source that the fast path is the compiled `recursive_schur_sqrtm` helper, which the final solver called directly.
root_cause.evidence_quote: Step 54: "The key optimization: bypass the `scipy.linalg.sqrtm` Python wrapper which computes an extra `||X@X - A||_F` error norm (an O(n^3) matmul) when `disp=False`, and call the underlying compiled `recursive_schur_sqrtm` C extension directly."
